title: Benefit Dollars, Per-Fill Limits and Benefit Periods of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The benefit-dollar settings of every program type in the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: the dollars available per benefit period, the per-fill limits, the fill-count limit, the days-supply ceiling, what starts a benefit period and the window for applying the program to an already-paid fill.

| Setting | Kestrel Rx Discount Card | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | Manufacturer Copay Card | Manufacturer Bridge Program | Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Program dollars per benefit period | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $9600.00 | $0.00 | $5000.00 |
| Per-fill benefit maximum applies | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Per-fill benefit maximum | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $800.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Patient minimum pay per fill after the program | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $5.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Limit on benefit fills per benefit period applies | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Most fills paid per benefit period | 0 | 0 | 0 | 13 | 3 | 0 |
| Largest days supply of a fill the program pays | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 30 | 90 |
| What starts a benefit period | Not applicable | Enrollment anniversary | Enrollment anniversary | Calendar year | Enrollment anniversary | Grant award date |
| Retro claim window (calendar days after a fill) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 180 | 30 | 90 |

## Terms

- **Program dollars per benefit period** — the dollars available per benefit period: $9600.00 on the Manufacturer Copay Card and $5000.00 on the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant; the other program types show $0.00 because they have no dollar budget.
- **Per-fill benefit maximum** — the most the program pays on one fill where the per-fill cap applies; only the Manufacturer Copay Card applies one, at $800.00.
- **Patient minimum pay** — the amount the patient always pays per fill after the program; $5.00 on the Manufacturer Copay Card.
- **Fill-count limit** — where it applies, the most fills the program pays per benefit period: 13 on the Manufacturer Copay Card and 3 on the Manufacturer Bridge Program.
- **Days-supply ceiling** — the largest days supply of a fill the program pays: 30 days on the Manufacturer Bridge Program, 90 days on every other program type.
- **What starts a benefit period** — *Calendar year* for the Manufacturer Copay Card, *Grant award date* for the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant, *Enrollment anniversary* for the club memberships and the Manufacturer Bridge Program, and *Not applicable* for the Kestrel Rx Discount Card.
- **Retro claim window** — the calendar days after a fill within which the program may be applied to that already-paid fill: 180 days on the Manufacturer Copay Card, 90 on the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant, 30 on the Manufacturer Bridge Program, and 0 on the three Kestrel discount programs.
